pages.title: FAQs
pages.content:
Frequently Asked Questions

Are the laptops new and boxed?

Yes — every laptop we sell is genuine and factory-boxed. Each boxed laptop comes with a FREE bag and mouse while the promo lasts.

Do you serve dealers and intermediaries?

Yes. We provide laptop information for all buyers and middlemen, with attractive wholesale prices. Call 0240999979 or 02086999988.

Where are your stores?

Accra — Haatso (Ecobank area), Kumasi — Asafo (Labour area), Tamale — Market area.

How much are the electric scooters?

Luxury electric bikes & scooters are available at our Accra store: GH₵ 7,000 / 10,000 / 12,000. Prices are fixed and non-negotiable.

How do I pay?

Cash on delivery in Accra, Mobile Money, bank transfer or card. See Payment Options for details.

Do you deliver outside Accra?

Yes — we deliver nationwide to Kumasi, Tamale and everywhere in Ghana.

What warranty do I get?

Boxed laptops carry their standard brand warranty. Our team also provides after-sale support — call us any time.

pages.title: Delivery Information
pages.content:
Nationwide Delivery

We deliver across Ghana. Same-day delivery within Accra for orders confirmed before 12 noon (terms apply).

  • Accra: same-day or next-day doorstep delivery
  • Kumasi & regional capitals: 1–2 business days
  • Other towns: 2–4 business days via trusted couriers

Delivery fee is shown at checkout — orders from GH₵ 1,000 qualify for free delivery.

pages.title: Return Policy
pages.content:
Easy 7-Day Returns

If a product is faulty on arrival or not as described, contact us within 7 days:

  • Products must be unused, in original packaging with all accessories.
  • Boxed laptops must retain their factory seal for change-of-mind returns.
  • Faulty units are replaced or repaired under the brand warranty.
  • Electric scooters are inspected with you at the store before handover.

Start a return by calling 0240 999979 or visiting the store where you bought the item.

pages.content:
Ways to Pay

  • Cash on Delivery — available in Accra
  • Mobile Money — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo Money (pay to the store line we confirm on call)
  • Bank transfer — details shared by our team when you order
  • Card — pay by card in our stores

Electric scooter prices (GH₵ 7k / 10k / 12k) are fixed and non-negotiable.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.content:
How to Order

  1. Browse laptops, computers, accessories or scooters and add to cart.
  2. Checkout with your delivery details — or simply call 0240 999979.
  3. We confirm stock, price and delivery time with you by phone/WhatsApp.
  4. Pay by cash on delivery, Mobile Money, bank transfer or card.
  5. Receive your order — boxed laptops include a FREE bag and mouse!

pages.title: Terms & Conditions
pages.content:
Terms & Conditions

By using this website or ordering from Cheap Laptops you agree to:

  • Prices are in Ghana cedis (GH₵) and may change without notice; scooter prices are fixed and non-negotiable.
  • Orders are confirmed by phone before dispatch; stock availability is subject to change.
  • Promo items (free bag & mouse) apply to boxed laptops only, while stock lasts.
  • Deliveries outside Accra are handled by third-party couriers.
  • Personal data is used only to process and deliver your order.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
Privacy Policy

We respect your privacy. We collect only the details needed to process your order (name, phone, delivery address, optional email).

  • Your data is never sold or shared with third parties except our delivery partners for fulfilment.
  • Payment details are handled through trusted channels; we do not store card numbers.
  • You can request deletion of your data any time by calling 0240 999979.
